_meta.name: ordinal_proportional_odds
_meta.description: Ordinal (proportional-odds) regression: REG_ORDINAL models the 1-5 recommend rating of battery.pulse from two other items of the battery, as MASS::polr does — one coefficient per predictor shifting every threshold of the scale alike (logit link: exp(coefficient) is the odds ratio of a higher rating), the four thresholds "1|2" .. "4|5" beside them, Wald standard errors from the observed information, the deviance, AIC and the mean fitted probability of each rating. params.brant adds the Brant test of the proportional-odds assumption: an omnibus chi-square and one per predictor of its effect being the same at every step of the scale.
